title: Aged-Account Points Taken Off the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Prompt-Pay Rate
content:
**Clause.** Aged-account points are taken off the prompt-pay rate of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account according to the statements issued on the account fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date: at least 5 statements take off 1 point; at least 3 but fewer than 5 statements take off 0.5 points; fewer than 3 statements take off none.

| Statements issued in the last 6 whole calendar months | Points taken off the prompt-pay rate |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 1 |
| 3 or 4 | 0.5 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 0 |

The points reduce the prompt-pay rate itself, which is then applied once to the charge.

**Example (hypothetical).** On an account statemented every 30 days, with the handling date a week after the latest statement, the last 6 whole calendar months hold 6 statements: 1 point is taken off. An account that first carried a balance three months ago holds 3 statements in that window: 0.5 points are taken off.
